title: Frame v1
description: One WebSocket message from an official broker stream, verbatim, as JSON Lines. Never carries a key, token, signature or handshake message. Một thông điệp WebSocket nguyên văn từ cổng stream chính thức; không bao giờ mang khoá, token, chữ ký hay thông điệp bắt tay.

kind.description: data: payload from the source. connected/reconnected: handshake and subscriptions done. gap: detail is {"from_ns", "to_ns"}, data in between may be missing. closed: detail is the reason.

channel.description: Channel family from streams.toml (tick, top_price...), 'unknown' if the type is not declared, empty on control frames.

conn_id.description: Which connection received it; grows on every reconnect.

seq.description: Assigned by the client, strictly increasing across reconnects, data and control frames alike.

payload.description: Text frames verbatim; binary frames base64. Empty on control frames.
